legend: Flow cytometry scatter plots. A Side scatter (SSC) versus CD45 histogram showing a major population of dim CD45+ blasts. Blasts are red; residual normal lymphocytes, blue; monocytes, purple; and granulocytes, brown. B The myeloid-associated markers CD33 and KIT (CD117) are expressed on the blasts, with variable CD33 up to levels comparable to those seen on the residual normal granulocytes (in brown). C The blasts are CD34+, and a small population of blasts coexpress CD56 and CD34. D Most of the blasts are positive for myeloperoxidase.
Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows, in addition to the myeloblasts, maturing granulocytic-lineage cells including promyelocytes, myelocytes, and mature neutrophils.
